writer.writes: Target vector fields, targets-alist, target and target.* dispatch globals
writer.owner: Immutable descriptor template + per-context selected-target instance
writer.closure: C begin! rewrites registered target; shallow sharing of target-get result is unsafe

writer.owner: Per-semantic-profile frozen base only after closure proof; mutable overlays per context
writer.closure: setup-prims plus target callbacks mutate procedure metadata; function pointer equality is not immutability

writer.writes: Clears c-intf decls/procs/inits/objs after extracting their values
writer.owner: Exclusive consumed input OR immutable snapshot + private emission copy
writer.closure: Field clearing does not prove extracted nested values are unaliased; nested graph census remains open

writer.writes: Interning tables, ordered tables, queues, resource records, labels, FP/sharing/name caches
writer.closure: begin/end reset globals but interior stores must be traced; normal end is not exceptional cleanup proof

writer.writes: Per-procedure code, labels, resources, frames, allocation reserves and debug accumulator
writer.closure: Table/cell/queue aliases can retain emission data after top-level reset

writer.writes: Representation graph/current block, FP cache and tuning flags
writer.owner: Profile configuration separated from per-procedure analysis graph
writer.closure: Some representation hooks are commented out; syntactic store inventory is not execution reachability

writer.writes: Output port, line counters, filenames, macro-definition/source tracking
writer.owner: Attempt-owned diagnostic/source sink plus caller-owned port lease
writer.closure: Normal close-output-port is not a cleanup guarantee on every exception path

writer.writes: Linker target begin/end, output state and module/link metadata
writer.owner: Native/link context with same semantic cohort rules
writer.closure: compile-only caller census excludes link consumers; both must migrate before retiring globals

fidelity.mustPreserve: Ordered declarations, annotation scope, section kind and phi-specific inlining policy
fidelity.counterexample: Flattening declaration scopes or dropping positive-phase inlining-limit changes compiler behavior
fidelity.admission: Encode declaration tree/scopes, not a set of options; compare to generated-file reader observation

fidelity.mustPreserve: Binding equality/distinction, namespace/phi, substitutions, quote-syntax lifts and initializer references
fidelity.counterexample: Canonicalizing distinct gensyms by spelling or stripping timestamp can collapse identities
fidelity.admission: Explicit injective binder/mark reconstruction and timestamp policy; no generic byte-equality claim

fidelity.mustPreserve: Baseline generated-file locations and reader/wrap/expand observations; original-source map separately labeled
fidelity.counterexample: sourcify-deep with one source is not automatically equivalent to read-source of emitted UTF-8/LF file
fidelity.admission: Baseline generated-view map required; richer original-origin diagnostics are an explicit enhancement

fidelity.mustPreserve: Phase-tagged diagnostics, nonzero subprocess status contract, output delivery and cleanup custody
fidelity.counterexample: Rethrowing a Gambit internal exception changes the current invoke nonzero-status compile-error surface
fidelity.admission: Compatibility adapter for existing observations; raw exception identity/continuation transport remains restricted

seal.inputGraph: Normalized nodes + environment + C-interface + module metadata

seal.sealCondition: Frozen snapshot with alias-preserving relocation; mutable target metadata and workspaces excluded

seal.inputGraph: Live current GVM/C-interface graph with owner-only access

seal.consumer: Current destructive emitter only under exclusive ownership
seal.cost: Avoids freeze copy but prevents reusable shared-stage credential

seal.inputGraph: Generated C bytes/descriptors + source/diagnostic projections + native requirements

seal.cost: Digest, atomic commit and diagnostic materialization

gain.avoided: Global target/primitive/emission serialization after complete ownership migration
gain.added: Private workspace and overlay memory, scheduling, possible IPC
gain.condition: Removed span exceeds added span; target registry/primitive sharing must be proven safe

gain.avoided: Repeated parse/normalize/lower for admitted equal inputs
gain.added: Freeze traversal + retained snapshot + private emission materialization
gain.condition: For k uses: (k-1)*frontWork > freezeCost + k*extraMaterialization + validation; cold single-use can lose

gain.avoided: Repeated Scheme file write/read and avoidable process boundary work
gain.condition: Removed serialization/startup exceeds codec + root custody cost; no gain from merely changing representation

gain.avoided: Unnecessary copying in a single-consumer noncached pipeline
gain.condition: Useful independent of reusable caching; must not count it again as shared snapshot savings
